Hi all — quick technical notes to help shape the eval plan:

- Hosted (EU): fastest to spin up. We can provision a hosted EU tenant with SOC2 controls enabled, E2E TLS, and customer-managed KMS for keys. Good for a 2–3 week baseline PoC.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, predictable tail latency, and stronger isolation — adds ~2–3 weeks to validate autoscaling and steady-state cost.
- Private: on-prem or VPC install; longer lead (procurement + infra), often 6–12 weeks depending on approvals.

Suggested tests for MAP (we'll provide runbooks):
- Latency P95/P99 under representative traffic (50–200 concurrent requests)
- Throughput sustained token/sec and cold-start behavior
- Model fidelity/regression on your prompt set (we’ll run before/after quantization)
- KV/prefix cache effectiveness for your session patterns
- Data residency verification (sample logs, KMS attestations)

We should also include a short cost sensitivity matrix (hosted vs. dedicated committed vs. private run-rate) so the procurement team can compare. I’ll attach a draft evaluation checklist to the Drive folder after our call.
